tagline: Offline-first · Zero-knowledge · Your keys, your cloud
create_vault_hint: Choose a strong master password. It is never sent anywhere and cannot be recovered if forgotten.
create_vault_warning: If you forget the master password, all data will be permanently lost.
vault_empty: Vault is empty. Add your first item.
title: Title
onboard_no_servers: No Vrav servers and no account — nothing to leak from us.
onboard_encrypted: Vault is encrypted with Argon2id + AES-256-GCM on your device.
onboard_master: Remember your master password: it cannot be reset.
onboard_create_hint: After create you can import from Bitwarden/Chrome or add items manually.
import_hub_hint: Merge passwords from another manager into this encrypted vault.
import_bitwarden_hint: Unencrypted Bitwarden JSON or CSV only.
import_bitwarden_steps: Bitwarden → Settings → Export vault → JSON or CSV (not encrypted).
import_chrome_steps: Chrome → Settings → Passwords → ⋮ → Export passwords → CSV.
sync_e2ee_hint: Only encrypted ciphertext is uploaded. Your cloud provider never sees passwords.
yandex_hint: Yandex Disk WebDAV: https://webdav.yandex.ru — login + app password.
export_json_warning: JSON contains plaintext secrets. One-time import only, then delete the file.
auto_lock_hint: Lock vault after inactivity or when app goes to background.
biometrics_hint: Unlock with fingerprint or face after first password unlock.
biometrics_unavailable: Biometrics not available on this device.
biometrics_security_note: Keys stay in platform secure storage.
biometrics_no_key: No biometric key saved. Unlock with password first.
